entity.summary: Self-custody hardware wallet brand operated by Yanssie HK Limited, focused on air-gapped signing devices and supporting software infrastructure.
entity.notes: Keystone states that the project began in 2018; Yanssie HK Limited was incorporated in Hong Kong in 2021.

products.summary: Current Keystone touchscreen hardware wallet with QR-based air-gapped operation and device-held private keys.
products.notes: Keystone's first-party site and official firmware repository establish the Keystone 3 Pro / Keystone 3 release lineage during 2023. WLR records year precision only because the reviewed sources do not establish one defensible exact first public-release day for Keystone 3 Pro.

events.title: Cobo Vault rebranded as Keystone
events.description: Keystone's official support documentation states that Cobo Vault was rebranded as Keystone on June 1, 2021 after the original hardware-wallet team left Cobo to create Keystone.
events.notes: The historical Cobo Vault hardware products are not yet canonical WLR products, so this entity-level continuity event intentionally has no affected_product_ids.

events.title: Keystone 3 Pro publicly introduced in official product design article
events.description: Keystone published its official Keystone 3 Pro product-design article as part of the 2023 Keystone 3 rollout chronology following the July forthcoming-launch announcement.
events.notes: This is an introduction/announcement anchor, not an asserted exact retail availability date.

events.title: Keystone publicly detailed the Keystone 3 Pro
events.description: Keystone published a first-party product article detailing the Keystone 3 Pro hardware wallet and its community-driven design and security architecture.
events.notes: This is a first-party public product-announcement milestone. It does not establish the exact first commercial shipment or general-release day, so the product launch_date remains unresolved.

events.title: Keystone 3 Pro released in 2023
events.description: Keystone's first-party product history and official Keystone 3 firmware release lineage establish Keystone 3 Pro as a released product during 2023.
events.notes: Year precision only. A July 2023 Keystone article still described the launch as forthcoming, while Pro-specific first-party content and firmware release history appear later in 2023; no exact commercial launch day is inferred.
